state.question: Ten fair independent coin flips are conditioned on exactly four heads. Arrange the ten positions in a circle, so positions 10 and 1 are adjacent. What is the conditional probability that no two heads are adjacent?
state.notation: pi is the circle constant; i is the imaginary unit; ln is natural logarithm; sqrt is the nonnegative square root; c is light speed; hbar is reduced Planck constant. * denotes multiplication and ^ a power.
